description: This Java class provide utilities for working with help text descriptions related to entity fields within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for retrieving field descriptions based on entity name, field name, delegator, and locale, utilizing OFBiz's model reader and property utilities.

classes.name: UtilHelpText
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods to retrieve help text descriptions for entity fields based on entity name, field name, delegator, and locale within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getEntityFieldDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the help text associated with a specified entity's field, falling back to resource property if no specific description is found, with logging for various conditions and errors.
